note: Hand-labelled word senses for scripts/measure-sense-images.js --relevance. A pair names a sense by the start of its Wiktionary gloss (tags stripped, as the script prints it); right and wrong list Commons files judged by eye for that sense; none: true means any picture not listed as right is wrong there; must: true means the sense has to show a right picture; mustNone: true means it has to show none. Relabelled after the second review: a keystone arch, a named pitcher's portrait, a Taoist diagram, the Chinese cun and an apple on the apple-tree sense are wrong.
